scope: C01 representative Windows direct-MCP baseline samples
method: Read-only Win32_Process query restricted to active engine_worker.py Python processes; no processes modified

field_interpretation.probe_peak_rss: Per-process peak working set of the owned Rust probe
field_interpretation.engine_peak_rss: Per-process peak working set of the probe connected.childPid, observed on Windows as the virtualenv launcher; this is not full Python engine RSS
field_interpretation.engine_worker_peak_rss: UNVERIFIED: not sampled in existing representative records
field_interpretation.engine_process_tree_peak_rss: UNVERIFIED: not measured; individual process high-water marks must not be summed and called a simultaneous tree peak

acceptance: Raw recorded numbers remain observations of their direct PIDs. They do not close full engine memory acceptance or establish native process-tree cleanup. No zero or total-memory estimate is substituted.
